summary: __thiscall point-in-rectangle hit test. Reads the rectangle origin x (this+0x14) and y (this+0x18) and extents (this+0xC, this+0x10), then returns 1 when point (a2, a3) is strictly inside the axis-aligned rectangle (a2 > x, a2 < x + width, a3 > y, a3 < y + height); returns 0 otherwise. Existing analysis labels the fields as left (0x14), top (0x18), width (0xC), height (0x10).

operations.description: Read the rectangle x origin v3 = this[5] at field this+0x14.
X-bounds guard: require a2 > v3 and a2 < v3 + this[3], where this[3] (field this+0xC) is the rectangle width; failure falls through to return 0.
Read the rectangle y origin v4 = this[6] at field this+0x18.
Y-bounds guard: require a3 > v4 and a3 < v4 + this[4], where this[4] (field this+0x10) is the rectangle height; failure falls through to return 0.
Return 1 when the point is inside both x and y bounds.
Return the pre-seeded result 0 when either guard fails.
Hit-test used by BoundsCheckWithPositionQuery (0x004773A0), UIWidgetProcessChildren (0x00490450) and PanelMouseInteractionHandler (0x00490550) for mouse/position hit testing.
